about: How tools/recolor-kennedi-skin.py finds Kennedi's skin in the cover. Gates are hue in degrees, saturation and value in 0-1. Only the regions holding a skin seed are recolored: the gates alone also match the pencil's wood and the beige shading on her shirt. Where no outline separates her skin from clothing, a seeded region runs on into it; inside each clothing box, pixels at or above its hue floor are clothing and keep their color (her skin peaks at hue 30).
